title: CI Q3 2026 deep dive: specialty pharmacy, cost initiatives, and model transition shape outlook
summary: Health insurance company Cigna (NYSE:CI) reported Q3 2026 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 6.1% year on year to $73.79 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $7.98 per share was 6.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
